title: Trader - Gift City Securities PLC Branch - Vice President / Associate
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Summary**
 Global Equities is part of the Investment Bank and offers solutions that include trade execution, program and special equity trading services; equity\-linked services and structuring for new equity\-linked issuances; marketing, structuring and trading services on equity\-based or fund\-based derivatives products; and a wide range of research, sales, execution, clearing, financing and reporting services.
   

  

 The Delta One desk is part of the Equity Derivatives Group and focuses on non\-volatility products. The desk transacts on behalf of customers and the firm's account in products including swaps, ETFs, and equity/index futures, spanning APAC and global indices, and offering short to long maturities on OTC and listed activity. The role is based in GIFT City (IFSC) and operates in alignment with applicable IFSCA regulatory and market requirements, while coordinating with broader APAC trading hubs and global partners.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Develop and enhance trading strategies through statistical analysis, signal research, and systematic modelling.
* Expand electronic market making and execution capabilities across Delta One products within the IFSC operating environment.
* Drive the Tech and Quant agenda required to scale systematic trading, pricing, and risk management.
* Build and maintain tools to improve research, trading, monitoring, and post\-trade analytics.
* Manage intraday risk, hedging, and position optimization across swaps, ETFs, and futures, in coordination with regional desks as needed.
* Partner with Sales, Structuring, Operations, and Controls to deliver client outcomes and ensure robust front\-to\-back processes.
* Support regulatory, surveillance, and governance expectations relevant to GIFT City (IFSC), including appropriate documentation and controls.


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Minimum 5 years of experience in Delta 1 Trading (or other relevant experience)
* Experience in dealing with IDB (Inter\-dealer brokers)
* Experience with pricing / market making / research of dividends
* Deep understanding of statistics and equity markets
* Strong equity market\-making background and proven track record in systematic trading
* The ability to refine and enhance our execution platform
* Good computing skills (R, Python, Java or C\#)


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, mathematics/statistics, economics, or a related quantitative discipline.
* Experience covering India market preferred but experience in other APAC markets (e.g. Hong Kong, Korea, Japan) and/or global index\-linked Delta One flows will also be considered.
* Familiarity with operating in a regulated trading environment with strong risk, controls, and governance expectations.
* Experience collaborating across time zones with regional/global trading and technology teams.


**About Us**
 JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
   

  

 We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
   

  

**About The Team**
 J.P. Morgan's Commercial \& Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial \& Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

title: Sr. Data Architect – Startups
description:
**Role Overview**
 We’re looking for a Senior Data Architect to own our data warehousing and database infrastructure across all our startups. You’ll design and build the systems that turn raw data into a reliable, scalable foundation for reporting and analytics, while owning day\-to\-day database administration, performance, and security. This is a high\-ownership role with the mandate to build the data backbone that supports every business unit.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design and build a scalable data warehouse architecture supporting multiple startups
* Design data models optimized for analytics and reporting
* Build, orchestrate, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines
* Administer, tune, and maintain PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server and MongoDB across environments
* Write and optimize advanced SQL queries; design and manage indexing strategies for performance
* Build data integrations and automation
* Define and enforce data governance, access control, and security standards
* Own backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity planning for all databases
* Monitor database health, proactively identify bottlenecks, and resolve performance issues
* Partner with engineering, product, and analytics teams to translate data needs into architecture
* Document data architecture, schemas, pipelines, and operational runbooks
* Monitor and optimize Azure cloud costs, ensuring infrastructure spend stays efficient as data volume and usage scale


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field; equivalent practical experience is welcome.

title: Industrial Engineer (P2)
description:
**About Analog Devices**
 Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
   

  

**Job Description Summary**
 Analog Devices is seeking an experienced Industrial Engineer to join the Central Industrial Engineering team. This role will lead high\-impact initiatives focused on capacity modeling, factory scheduling, cycle time reduction, operations research, and productivity improvement across ADI's front\-end manufacturing network. The successful candidate will drive development of cross\-site analytical models, optimization tools, and data\-driven decision systems that maximize factory output, support expansion planning, and establish standardized Industrial Engineering practices across multiple manufacturing sites.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead development of cross\-site capacity models, utilization analyses, loading scenarios, and expansion planning studies.
* Drive cycle time reduction and WIP optimization initiatives through Factory Physics methodologies, bottleneck analysis, and constraint management.
* Develop and maintain advanced analytical tools supporting factory scheduling, output optimization, and operational decision making.
* Perform operations research and statistical analyses to identify key output levers and productivity improvement opportunities.
* Design and implement predictive models, optimization algorithms, and AI\-enabled analytical solutions for manufacturing applications.
* Lead validation and continuous improvement of scheduling logic, factory planning assumptions, and manufacturing data structures.
* Establish standard methodologies, governance processes, and best practices across multiple manufacturing sites.
* Mentor junior Industrial Engineers and provide technical leadership on analytical projects.
* Partner with site leadership, operations teams, supply chain, manufacturing engineering, and IT to drive strategic improvement initiatives.
* Present recommendations, scenario analyses, and business cases to management and senior leadership.
* Support development of long\-range capacity plans and fab expansion scenarios.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, Manufacturing Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related engineering discipline.
* Proficiency in SQL, Python, Power BI, and statistical analysis tools.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's Degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, Data Science, Analytics, or related field.
* Semiconductor wafer fabrication experience.
* Experience with Factory Physics, cycle time engineering, capacity planning, production scheduling, or manufacturing optimization.
* Experience with simulation, optimization modeling, machine learning, or operations research techniques.


**Work Experience**
* 3–5 years of Industrial Engineering experience in semiconductor manufacturing or other complex manufacturing environments.
* Experience building capacity models, productivity analyses, factory scheduling models, or optimization tools.
* Demonstrated success leading cross\-functional improvement initiatives.
* Strong analytical, communication, and project leadership skills.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams is preferred.


*For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce \- Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State \- Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3\) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.*
*Analog Devices is an equal opportunity employer. We foster a culture where everyone has an opportunity to succeed regardless of their race, color, religion, age, ancestry, national origin, social or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, parental status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, union membership, and political affiliation, or any other legally protected group.*
 Job Req Type: Experienced
   

  

 Required Travel: Yes, 10% of the time
   

  

 Shift Type: 1st Shift/Days

title: Actuarial Analyst
description:
The Actuarial Analyst will be responsible for evaluating, underwriting, and managing reinsurance risks in line with the company's underwriting strategy, risk appetite, and regulatory requirements. This role will support profitable business growth while ensuring compliance with IFSCA regulations, internal underwriting guidelines, and group policies applicable.
 



  





***Role \& Responsibilities***



* Assess, evaluate, and approve facultative and treaty reinsurance risks in line with approved underwriting guidelines, delegated authority limits, and risk appetite.
* Develop, maintain, and periodically review pricing models, risk selection criteria, underwriting frameworks, and exposure management standards.
* Ensure adherence to approved risk appetite, underwriting governance requirements, accumulation controls, and exposure limits.
* Work closely with brokers, cedants, and business partners to support business development, client retention, and profitable portfolio growth.
* Monitor portfolio performance, loss ratios, claims trends, premium adequacy, and overall underwriting profitability.
* Coordinate with actuarial, risk management, and finance teams to assess pricing adequacy, portfolio performance, reserving trends, and capital implications.
* Review submissions, exposure data, claims history, and market information to determine appropriate pricing, terms, conditions, and capacity deployment.
* Negotiate reinsurance contract terms, coverage conditions, exclusions, and pricing with cedants and intermediaries.
* Ensure documentation quality, contract certainty, and compliance with international reinsurance practices, regulatory requirements, and internal policies.
* Maintain accurate underwriting records, risk assessments, and management information systems.
* Monitor catastrophe exposures, concentration risks, and portfolio accumulations to ensure effective risk management.
* Ensure compliance with IFSCA regulations, internal underwriting policies, sanctions requirements, AML obligations, and applicable governance standards applicable to IIO operations.
* Provide regular portfolio analysis, underwriting reports, and performance updates to the Principal Officer and parent entity.
* Provide insights and recommendations to the Principal Officer regarding market developments, competitive dynamics, emerging risks, reinsurance pricing trends, and underwriting strategy.
* Support regulatory reporting, audits, inspections, and information requests from IFSCA and other relevant authorities.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with cedants, brokers, reinsurers, and other market participants to support the branch's strategic objectives.



  





***Education***



* Bachelor’s degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field
* Associate or near Associate of a recognized actuarial body (e.g., SOA, CAS, IFoA, CIA or equivalent).



  





***Experience***



* Minimum of 8 years of overall experience.
* Minimum of 8 years of progressive responsibilities in an actuarial role, including leading projects, processes, and staff.
* General Insurance, Pricing, and underwriting experience is a must.

title: MIS Executive
description:

**Job Summary:**
 The MIS Executive will be responsible for managing and monitoring daily operational reports across Atlanta, Northcap, and Vivyx operations. The role involves ensuring data accuracy, tracking production and dispatch activities, and coordinating with teams to close open action points in a timely manner.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Manage and maintain daily MIS reports for Atlanta, Northcap, and Vivyx operations
* Monitor daily production reports and ensure data accuracy and completeness
* Track daily issuance reports and highlight discrepancies if any
* Oversee daily dispatch and return reports for smooth operational flow
* Follow up with internal teams to ensure closure of pending/open points
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams for updates and issue resolution
* Ensure timely reporting and adherence to defined processes


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* Strong knowledge of MS Excel (formulas, pivot tables, data analysis)
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Strong follow\-up and coordination abilities
* Attention to detail and accuracy in reporting

**Preferred Experience**

**Key Competencies**
